runtime_evidence: Context-only prints and saves actual own process context and implementation inventory before any material read/reconstruction. Production first prints a compact generation-qualified context event, then actual useful checkpoint events. Summary.prev rotation, telemetry JSONL and unique all-exit terminal documents. No verbose multi-megabyte stdout dump. Root owns actual user-unit preflight/admission/launch, notifier/view and outcome intake. source_wave_rule: Source authors write only their producer and skip builds/tests/scientific imports/numerical launches. The shared contract must be settled first. Root owns integration and execution. New code source must be bound before use; inputs from the previous wave have settled. Production still requires a separately measured process grant; this is source authorization only.
recovery_scope: Committed background/spin/probe factor boundaries only. No unfinished calculation, Native history or power-loss promise. One bounded current-generation isolated summary-writer crash/readback can cover both completed new producers; do not replay prior proofs.
publication: No early support PR or campaign completion/merge claim. Preserve local raw artifacts and explicit source/results receipts; canonical issue225 remains authority.
